## PLUGIN CONFIG SCHEMA (authoritative — read validators carefully)
The planner prompt's JSON schema below cannot represent `@model_validator(mode='after')` or cross-field `@field_validator` bodies. Treat the source below as the single source of truth for any cross-field invariants; a proposed config that violates one will be rejected by the resource-eval skill and burn a retry attempt.

```python
class PeWavenetDeltaConfig(BaseModel):
    model_type: str = Field(default="pe_wavenet_delta")
    segmentation_size: int = Field(default=1000, ge=1)
    batch_size: int = Field(default=1, ge=1)
    hidden_dim: int = Field(default=128, ge=8, le=8192)

```
